title: fix(platform-objects): the Setup Users list and the user record highlights stop showing the legacy role scalar
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XD5Csq4vbvdCSTJt7KnCqYG)_

Fixes #28105

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Setup → 用户列表（`all_users` 视图）去掉「Platform Role」一列；用户记录页顶部的高亮条去掉「Platform Role」一格。字段 `sys_user.role` 本身不动：仍是只读文本、仍在 Admin 分组、数据 API 照旧可读。
- **为什么改**：这一列是 better-auth 的遗留字段，平台从不写它；admin 插件开着时它给每个人都盖 `user`，种子平台管理员也是 `user`（本地实测见下）。平台管理员身份来自 ADR-0068 D2（所有者邮箱或无组织的 `admin_full_access`），不来自这一列。按裁决 D1（Ruling-ref: 6557746678）撤掉这个误导的展示面；真实身份推导的一列另立 #28793。
- **风险与回滚**：低。纯展示面改动，无类型、存储、选项或 spec 变化；已存的用户列表个性化视图不受影响（它们存自己的列）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`（`record:highlights` 的 `fields`，高亮其实住在记录页，不在对象的 `highlightFields`）；`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（`all_users.columns`）；`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-list-columns.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/identity/sys-user-list-columns.test.ts src/pages/sys-user-record-highlights.test.ts`，预期 8/8 通过（main 上 4 红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`all_users` list view** (`sys-user.object.ts`): columns are now `name, email, phone_number, email_verified, banned, source, created_at`. `role` is gone; `banned` stays (#27863). The column comment says why.
- **User record page highlights** (`pages/sys-user.page.ts`): the `record:highlights` chip strip of `sys_user_detail` is now `email, phone_number, email_verified`. The details grid's `hideFields` keeps `role` (its comment now says why: not the platform role, rather than "already promoted to highlights"), and no details section names it, so the record page draws `role` nowhere. The page docblock no longer lists "platform role" among the signals.
- **Unchanged, per ruling D1:** the `sys_user.role` field (`Field.text`, readonly, `maxLength: 64`, group `Admin`, label and description), its storage, the better-auth `defaultRole` stamp, and the ADR-0092 import / create-user pass-through. No synchronisation of platform-admin standing into the scalar. No `packages/spec/**` or `ui/**` edit.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28105-sys-user-role-off-setup-screens.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/platform-objects` (served view and page metadata change; no authorable value is refused, no key moves).

## Tests

- **Pin renamed and moved with the ruling.** `identity/sys-user-list-status-role-columns.test.ts` (the #27863 pin, PR #28065) is now `identity/sys-user-list-columns.test.ts`, since its name named the Role column. It pins the new `all_users` columns, that no `sys_user` list view lists `role`, that the object `highlightFields` do not carry it, that every column is a declared field, and that `role` is still readonly `text` in group `Admin` with no `options` (ruling 2 guard).
- **New page pin** `pages/sys-user-record-highlights.test.ts`: the header chip strip is exactly `email, phone_number, email_verified`; no `record:highlights` node anywhere on the page (tab children walked) carries `role`; no `record:details` section draws it and `hideFields` keeps it.
- **Red first, on base `d9c4cdc4e`** (both files against base sources): 4 failed / 4 passed. Red: the `all_users` columns pin, "no list view shows role", the chip-strip pin, "no highlights node carries role". Green on base as well as head: object `highlightFields` (already `name, email, email_verified` on base), every column declared, the role-field guard, the details-section check.
- **Green on head:** the two files 8/8; `@objectstack/platform-objects` full suite and typecheck green (numbers in Verification). The existing `pages/sys-user-details-tab.test.ts` pin of `hideFields` is unchanged and green.
- No ablation: the change is declarative metadata, and the red-on-base run above is the pins' negative leg.

## Acceptance notes

- **Mechanism (order assumption 1, confirmed).** The record highlight showing `role` was not the object-level `highlightFields` (`['name', 'email', 'email_verified']` on base) but the `record:highlights` node of the record page `sys_user_detail`. No compact layout exists (`compactLayout` is a retired key). The claim's file surface was amended to add the page file and its folder's tests.
- **Other readers of `sys_user.role` (order assumption 2).** No other platform view, dashboard, report or example reads it as a column. The `role` columns in `sys_member`, `sys_invitation`, `sys_scim_projection_grant` and the related lists on the organization and user pages are membership / grant roles of other objects, not this scalar. Non-Setup readers left alone: the Console import panel's `role` column (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/IdentityImportPanels.tsx`, the ADR-0092 import pass-through), the expression-context `user.role` and its `${user.role === 'admin'}` example in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx` (the ui finding the seat carries), and `packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-ledger-decision-metadata.dogfood.test.ts`, which reads the field label, not a list column.
- **Still reads "Platform Role".** The field's label stays `Platform Role` (ruling 2: no field change), so the standard edit form and the data API keep that label. Noted, not changed.
- **Saved personal list views** that copied `role` into their own column list keep it; this PR changes only the shipped `all_users` default.
- No `content/docs/**` page pins the Users list columns (grep for the column list, `all_users` and `Platform Role` under `content/docs`: zero hits).

## Verification

<details><summary>Live probe, stock showcase boot, base vs head</summary>

Commands (each leg on a fresh boot, platform-objects `dist/` rebuilt for that leg; the base leg wrote the base blobs of the two source files over the head copies, then restored them with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty and both blob hashes equal to HEAD before the head `dist/` was rebuilt):

```
pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT
curl -c jar -H 'Origin: http://localhost:PORT' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -X POST http://localhost:PORT/api/v1/auth/sign-in/email -d '{"email":"admin@objectos.ai","password":"admin123"}'
curl -b jar -H 'Origin: http://localhost:PORT' http://localhost:PORT/api/v1/meta/object/sys_user      # item.listViews.all_users.columns, item.highlightFields, item.fields.role
curl -b jar -H 'Origin: http://localhost:PORT' http://localhost:PORT/api/v1/meta/page/sys_user_detail # every record:highlights node's fields
curl -b jar -H 'Origin: http://localhost:PORT' 'http://localhost:PORT/api/v1/data/sys_user?fields=id,email,role&limit=2'
```

| read | base `d9c4cdc4e` (port 4625) | head (port 4615) |
|---|---|---|
| sign-in | 200 | 200 |
| `all_users.columns` | `name, email, phone_number, email_verified, banned, role, source, created_at` | `name, email, phone_number, email_verified, banned, source, created_at` |
| object `highlightFields` | `name, email, email_verified` | `name, email, email_verified` |
| page `record:highlights` (header) | `email, phone_number, email_verified, role` | `email, phone_number, email_verified` |
| page `record:highlights` (Security tab) | `two_factor_enabled` | `two_factor_enabled` |
| `fields.role` | text, readonly, group Admin | text, readonly, group Admin, label Platform Role |

Head data read: `admin@objectos.ai` (the showcase's seeded dev admin) answers `"role": "user"`; `auditor.demo@example.com` answers `"role": null`. That is the wrong value the ruling describes, and the field stays readable through the data API.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates, local subset, at head 280a84dd (59 derived families, all exit 0)</summary>
